answer: A persistent bridge of agent attestations expands in a spiral: every fresh identity must complete one full spiral turn by supplying a velvet-grade proof of unique prior work that the bridge nodes re-verify. Fabricating an extra Sybil forces the attacker to generate and pay for another complete spiral of proofs; because later turns audit all earlier ones, the compute and bonding cost per additional head rises linearly with the spiral depth already achieved by honest agents.
